messages:
Jordan: Quick check — final changelog grooming for v1.8.0. Cutoff is today 17:00 PT. Please add a one-liner to KEEP_A_CHANGELOG and tag the component. If you need a version bump, call it out here. Example entry format (keep it short):
```
- runtime: defer KV flush to reduce peak memory (internal)
```
Priya: Added my one-liner under `infra:` and linked PR #6123. Also opened `release/bump-v1.8.0` with the version bump.
Sam: I pushed a small change to `CHANGELOG.md` (formatting only) and opened PR #6125 to bump the package. No functional code.
Oliver: Heads-up — I have one user-facing wording that needs product review. Marked it as `docs:` and left a TODO in the entry. I'll hand that to @pm-review before cutoff.
release-bot: changelog-lint: PR #6123 passed lint :white_check_mark:. PR #6125 has a minor style warning (fixed by maintainer).
Jordan: Nice. A couple of reminders:
- please start entries with a component tag like `runtime:`, `console:`, `model:`, `docs:`
- keep them one sentence; we write customer-facing summaries separately
- add `(internal)` when it is not customer-facing
Also if you bump the version, put the bump PR title as `release: bump vX.Y.Z` so automation picks it up.
Priya: Question: should `optimize` related items be under `runtime:` or `optimize:`? I used `runtime:` to avoid proliferation.
Sam: `runtime:` is fine for anything that affects serving/runtime perf. `optimize:` is more for tooling suggestions (Optimize product).
Oliver: For backports — I will cherry-pick the dedupe fix to `release-1.7` after the RC is cut. No changelog edit needed there.
qa-robot: test-run: queued for branch `release/bump-v1.8.0`. Estimated run time ~10m.
Sam: Quick operational note — please do not edit `CHANGELOG.md` directly if you already have a PR open. Push changes to your PR to avoid conflicts.
Jordan: I'll do a final sweep at 16:45 PT and announce the freeze at 17:00 PT. If you want me to adjust wording for any entry, reply here before 16:30.
Priya: Done, thanks.
Oliver: Pinged QA in #eng-sre and flagged the one doc wording for PM review.
Sam: LGTM — aiming to merge bump PRs once CI + QA green. :rocket:
Jordan: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. :tada:
